categories.main_business_segments: Chia Ta World Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the manufacturing, processing, and trading of steel wire products including general steel wire, galvanized steel wire, prestressed steel wire, steel strands, steel cables, springs, and mechanical hardware parts. The company also operates in wholesale and services related to office machinery, information software, precision instruments, lighting equipment, electronic materials, and computer equipment installation. International trade is also a significant part of its business activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced wire drawing and galvanizing processes, including acid pickling and heat treatment, to produce high-quality steel wire products. Recent upgrades include the installation of new wire drawing machines and improvements to acid pickling tanks to enhance rust removal and product quality. Environmental compliance is maintained through wet scrubber systems for waste gas treatment and wastewater treatment facilities, ensuring adherence to pollution control standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the motorcycle, automobile, bicycle, public engineering, transportation equipment, furniture, and construction sectors. The products serve applications such as cable cores for electrical wiring, telecommunications overhead lines, packaging galvanized steel wire, steel cables for fishing and shipping, springs for mattresses and sports equipment, and prestressed steel for foundations and bridges. The domestic market accounts for over 90% of sales, with the remainder distributed mainly in Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with approximately 90% of sales domestic and about 10% exported to other Asian markets. There is ongoing effort to expand and deepen market presence in Japan, the United States, China, and Southeast Asia to diversify export markets and reduce concentration risks.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chia Ta World operates in the midstream segment of the steel industry supply chain, focusing on processing and manufacturing steel wire products from raw steel billets and wire rods sourced domestically and internationally. It procures raw materials such as wire rods and zinc blocks from major steel producers and trading companies, then processes these into finished steel wire and related products for downstream customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous quality improvement and production efficiency through process data analysis and equipment upgrades, including new wire drawing machines and enhanced acid pickling systems. It aims to diversify raw material sourcing to reduce costs and supply risks, develop customized product grades to meet varied customer needs, and strengthen customer communication and service. Environmental sustainability is pursued via solar power installations and compliance with ISO 9001:2015 quality management standards.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of steel wire products and related mechanical hardware parts. The company also earns income from interest and dividends. Sales contracts are typically based on volume shipments aligned with project progress, and procurement is managed via seasonal purchasing agreements for raw materials.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces strong competition from large-scale steel wire and cable manufacturers in China and Southeast Asia, which benefit from lower raw material costs and economies of scale. Chia Ta differentiates itself through higher product quality, diversified and customized product offerings, and stable customer relationships. It maintains a competitive position by focusing on cost control, quality enhancement, and market responsiveness.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In fiscal year 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately NT$577.65 million, with a net profit of NT$15.72 million, marking a turnaround from losses in the prior year. The gross margin improved significantly to 13.42%, supported by cost reductions and price adjustments. Total assets stood at about NT$1.2 billion, with shareholders' equity around NT$1.04 billion. The company shows a stable growth trajectory with cautious capital expenditure and debt reduction strategies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chia Ta World offers high-quality steel wire products that meet stringent domestic and international standards, supported by ISO 9001 certification and multiple product certifications. The company emphasizes customized product grading to satisfy diverse customer requirements and provides reliable after-sales service. Its commitment to environmental compliance and sustainable practices, including solar energy use and pollution control, further differentiates it in the market.
